avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces upadacitinib exposure and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort; do not co-administer with upadacitinib

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May enhance immune stimulation, potentially counteracting JAK inhibitor immunosuppression
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on infection risk mitigation

avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Immune system stimulation may antagonize JAK inhibitor effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use only under medical supervision with close monitoring

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase upadacitinib levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for adverse effects; consider alternative supplements

caution_supplements.name: Curcumin/Turmeric
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild CYP3A4 inhibitory effects
caution_supplements.action: No dose adjustment needed; routine monitoring appropriate

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may moderately increase upadacitinib exposure
caution_foods.action: Limit or avoid grapefruit juice; counsel on consistent dietary patterns

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay absorption and alter bioavailability timing
caution_foods.action: Take on consistent schedule; food timing less critical than consistency

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of infection given JAK inhibitor immunosuppression; assess liver function and lipid panels periodically. Educate patients on avoiding immune-stimulating supplements and maintaining consistent meal timing patterns.
